what_to_detect: A continuous record whose snapshot shows a permanent represented by two or more components: a merged permanent.
near_miss: A continuous record on a permanent with a single component.
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role)

what_to_detect: A merged permanent whose characteristics (name, colours, types, power and toughness) are those of its topmost component.
near_miss: A merged permanent whose characteristics differ from its topmost component's (an effect that merged them specified otherwise).
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role)

what_to_detect: An enters-the-battlefield trigger evaluated for an object that merged with a permanent, fired false: merging is not entering.
near_miss: The same kind of trigger evaluated for an object that entered the battlefield normally, fired true.
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role)

what_to_detect: An attackers legality record listing a merged permanent among the legal attackers when the permanent it merged onto was not summoning sick: the merged permanent is the same object.
near_miss: An attackers record forbidding a merged permanent whose pre-merge permanent was summoning sick or under an attack restriction.
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role)

what_to_detect: A merged permanent with a token component is a token exactly when its topmost component is a token: its entity carries a token_script_id iff the topmost component does, and a creature-token target restriction admits it into legal_targets.
near_miss: A merged permanent with a token component under a card on top: not a token, outside a token-only target restriction's legal_targets.
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role)

what_to_detect: A turned-face-up trigger evaluated on a face-down permanent that became face up because a face-up object merged on top of it, fired false: merging does not count as turning face up.
near_miss: A turned-face-up trigger evaluated on a face-down permanent actually turned face up (a face_change to front), fired true.
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role)

what_to_detect: A face-down merged permanent turned face up: a face_change event to face up turning every face-down component face up, and a turned-face-up trigger evaluated.
near_miss: A face-down permanent with a single component turned face up.
record_fields: gen-3 card face_state of each component
gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role)

what_to_detect: A face-up merged permanent turned face down: a face_change event to face_down turning every face-up component face down.
near_miss: A face-up permanent with a single component turned face down.
record_fields: gen-3 card face_state of each component
gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role)

what_to_detect: A merged permanent containing a flip card flipped: a face_change event to flipped, after which the permanent's characteristics are the flip component's alternative ones.
near_miss: A flip of a permanent with a single component.
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role)

what_to_detect: A merged permanent containing a double-faced component transformed: a face_change event with each double-faced component turned to its other face.
near_miss: A transform of a permanent with a single component.
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role)

what_to_detect: A turn-face-down effect (SetState, Mode$ TurnFaceDown) meeting a face-up merged permanent that contains a double-faced component: Forge's SetStateEffect skips it, so no face_change names it and its face_state stays front.
near_miss: A turn-face-down effect meeting a face-up merged permanent with no double-faced component: a face_change to face_down names it.
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role)

what_to_detect: A merged permanent leaving the battlefield: one zone_change from the battlefield per component, every component going to the appropriate zone.
near_miss: A permanent with a single component leaving the battlefield: one zone_change.
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role) in the snapshot before the resolution

what_to_detect: An effect that finds the new object a merged permanent became as it left the battlefield acts on every component: one zone_change per component of the merged permanent the effect exiled.
near_miss: The same kind of effect on a permanent with a single component: one zone_change.
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role) in the snapshot before the resolution

what_to_detect: A replacement effect applied to a merged permanent's move to the graveyard applies to every component: the rewrite record's incoming zone_change names a merged permanent and the result is replaced.
near_miss: A merged permanent's move to the graveyard meeting a replacement effect that did not replace it.
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role)

what_to_detect: A replacement effect for a card being put into a zone meeting a merged permanent: it applies to every component when the merged permanent is not a token, and only to the card components when it is a token.
near_miss: Such a replacement meeting a merged permanent's move and not applying (it does not apply to that player's graveyard).
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot cards mutate_components (the merged permanent's components, with their role)
